entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production 2D game animation sprite sheet, IAmiguinho TABLE TENNIS CELEBRATION, exactly eight frames in a 4-column by 2-row grid in reading order. Wide 2:1 image, target 1776x888, eight equal 444x444 cells.
REFERENCES: Image1 is the ONLY canonical IAmiguinho design/proportions/style; image2 is ONLY the layout guide and scale; image3 is the approved paddle shape/materials in several angles. Never copy their labels or guide marks. Do not draw a model sheet or extra props.
MODEL LOCK: Huge cream round head, dark navy glass visor always completely blank without eyes/mouth/emission, blue/cream striped cap and blue two-blade propeller, blue headphones with cyan rings. Tiny egg cream torso, short thin cream limbs, white gloves FIVE fingers each (4 fingers and thumb; curl them anatomically when gripping), blue wristbands, large blue sneakers with white soles. Exactly 2 arms,2 hands,2 legs. Same head and limb sizes in ALL poses; no lanky adult torso. Hand-painted cartoon rich painterly brushwork, thick organic dark navy outlines, top-left light.
LAYOUT LOCK: Use the guide exactly proportionally: per 444px cell center x222, grounded shoe bottoms y406. Neutral propeller top y81, cap top y114, chin y248: head size 134px high cap-to-chin, body neck-to-ground158px, propeller35px. Keep these dimensions even jumping/bending. Head stays near x222. Airborne frames rise about30–45px, no camera/scale change. Every sprite and paddle fully within cell with at least12px margin. No borders, guide lines, lettering, numbers, shadows, floor, motion lines, particles or ball. Uniform flat opaque #00FF00 background.
PADDLE LOCK: One identical approved table-tennis paddle held securely by the SAME near/front gloved hand in every frame. Red rubber oval blade, dark navy reverse, thin pale layered wood edge, short natural cream wood handle. Total paddle length100px at444pxcell scale, oval blade about70px wide. Size NEVER changes with action except perspective foreshortening. Grip handle, not blade. Other hand is always empty. It remains in his hand during wrist twirl.
CAMERA: strict side view facing RIGHT through the action; no spin of the character. Show enough thickness on headphones/head and blade to match canonical side reference.
ANIMATION, exact eight poses:
1 top-left: ready stance with softly bent knees, paddle in front of waist, red face toward viewer, free hand relaxed forward.
2: preparatory crouch a little lower, free hand closed into small fist, paddle near waist.
3: jumping upward, both feet off ground, near paddle arm raised so paddle is high like a trophy with red face toward camera, free fist rising; use short bent arm anatomy.
4 top-right: apex of modest jump, both arms raised, paddle high, legs gently tucked. Head does not shrink, arm/leg lengths unchanged.
5 bottom-left: descending, feet still airborne, paddle starts lowering slightly, free arm lowering toward chest.
6: landing with knees absorbing, free hand doing small fist pump at chest, paddle upright beside head.
7: wrist turns paddle while still held, show its THIN EDGE toward camera, free hand relaxes, body straightening.
8 bottom-right: proud ready stance, grounded, paddle in front of waist, red face visible, closely match frame1 for return.
Prioritize faithful model, even grid placement, clean readable hand grips, and continuous movement. No face or extra paddle in any cell.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a surgical correction to the attached 8-frame robot celebration sheet. Change ONLY two local details; preserve all other pixels, poses, size, design, puregreen background,4x2 layout.
A) TOP ROW SECOND CELL, crouching robot: its NEAR/front white-gloved hand (the hand on the left side of this sprite, at the front hip near local x200,y330) must visibly HOLD THE PADDLE. Keep paddle arm unchanged. Keep the empty hand empty, same fingers curled into a fist. Don't lengthen the arm; rotate the upper arm upward and bend the elbow anatomically. Keep head, paddle, legs and airborneposition identical.

In frame4 both floating hands up, keep paddle a little to the LEFT of body top so it has space without shrinking body. Frame7 paddle seen thin edge. Exactly same paddle size throughout.
Retain all other celebration action, same body volume, same small hand/foot sizes. Visor always blank. Do not draw grid or guides, labels, text, shadows, floors, balls, effects or extra objects. Background perfectly flat #00FF00.
entries.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE professional animation sprite sheet for the exact pink AMIGUINHO jelly character in reference image 1, performing a TABLE TENNIS CELEBRATION. Reference image 2 is layout only: copy its four equal columns and two equal rows, then OMIT every guide, line, label, number and border. Reference image 3 is the approved paddle design, not the ball. Draw exactly eight full isolated frames in reading order. Landscape 2:1 canvas, ideally 1776x888, each invisible cell 444x444. Ground local y=406; in a neutral standing pose body top local y=85. Same anatomical scale in every frame, same volume of pink jelly in every squash/stretch, unchanged small floating round hand sizes and small domed foot sizes. Keep body near local x=222 throughout. No frame touches its cell edges. Use a modest jump so even the raised paddle stays fully inside its cell with generous safety margin.
Character: identical hand-painted pink egg-shaped jelly body from the model, navy glossy visor in upper half, completely BLANK dark glass with only faint reflection, NO eyes, mouth, expression or symbols. Exactly two round pink floating ball hands and two small pink floating feet, NO arms, NO legs, NO fingers, no cap, no clothes. Side view facing RIGHT throughout, faithfully matching the side view of the model. Hands float unattached.
Prop: ONE SAME table-tennis paddle held by its cream wooden handle in the near/front floating hand in EVERY frame; never changes hands and never detaches. Round red rubber face, thin cream wood edge, dark navy rubber back. Fixed size in all frames and both animation sheets: total paddle length 100 px in the 444px cell, blade width 70px. Body proportions do not change to accommodate paddle. Red face oriented toward viewer when lifted; frame7 thin edge only. No ball.
Eight frames:
1 ready stance, paddle in near floating hand in front of lower visor/waist, opposite floating hand resting separately.
2 big anticipatory squash, wider and lower but same jelly volume, paddle still held.
3 joyful jelly jump, feet leaving baseline, near hand raises paddle high like a trophy, red face toward viewer.
4 apex of modest jump, jelly body stretched tall and narrower conserving volume, both separate floating hands up, paddle high, feet visibly off ground.
5 coming down, less stretched, paddle still raised.
6 landing squash on ground line, wobbling happily, near hand holds paddle beside visor, free hand up.
7 happy jelly wiggle recovering, paddle rotated in same hand so only its thin side edge is visible.
8 return to ready stance matching frame1, confidently upright, paddle forward.
Consecutive poses follow one continuous action with credible in-between motion. Thick organic dark navy outline, detailed hand-painted cartoon brushwork exactly like reference, warm highlights from TOP LEFT consistently. Flat uniform pure chroma green RGB(0,255,0) background everywhere outside sprites. No cast shadows, floor, dust, motion lines, ball, scene, text, labels, grid, numbers, extra paddles or extra body parts. Do not include reference images within result.
entries.notes: Corrected to true right-facing profile. Eight frames, frame7 thin-edge paddle. Source airborne feet now above ground but final registration recommended. The generated neutral blob height is smaller than disappointment; normalize pair to guide/standing size without distorting shape.
entries.paddle_edit_prompt: Precise object edit of the supplied eight-frame pink Amiguinho sprite sheet. Change ONLY THE TABLE TENNIS PADDLE SIZE in all eight frames. Scale each complete paddle blade AND wooden handle uniformly to 64 percent of its current linear dimensions, about its grip point where the wooden handle meets the pink floating hand. Keep the paddle held coherently in exactly that same hand. The paddle must become visibly smaller. Keep its red face, navy reverse, thin cream wooden edge, wooden handle and the exact orientation in each frame; the edge-on paddle remains edge-on. Do not move, resize, reshape, repaint or change ANY other element: each body, visor, floating hand, foot, pose, location, lighting, shading, navy outlines, cell arrangement, background and crop MUST remain pixel-aligned and visually unchanged. The round pink hands must NOT shrink. Preserve eight frames in four columns and two rows, no borders, no labels. Preserve flat pure green background. Visors remain empty. NO additional objects or ball. Only the eight paddles get smaller.
